args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (deployed to all production regions) is failing health checks with an elevated error rate (18%). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Rollback**
- checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), which was failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
- Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1 was unhealthy; v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 were both healthy).
- Rolled back to **v2.3.0** in all regions. Verified post-rollback: service is **healthy** with error rate back down to 0.2%.

**Incident**
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the v2.3.1 health-check failure, the elevated error rate, and the rollback to v2.3.0. On-call has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1 remains the unhealthy release in the deployment history — root cause investigation is now tracked under INC-0001 before any re-deploy attempt.
